name: copyable-text
title: Copyable text
description: A value you copy with one click, such as an order id, an email or a hash: the text is the button, the icon is always visible, and a check confirms the copy in place.
docs: label names what is copied, so the button reads "Copy order id: ORD-1048". display writes a short form while value is copied whole, and truncate="middle" keeps the end of a long id visible. A value that wraps carries its icon along, so it stays beside the last word. Where the browser blocks the clipboard the text is selected and the tooltip asks for Ctrl C. status shows the copied or the blocked state without a press, for a preview.
